name: Notes counter
description: Keeps short notes and counts them. The example plugin: a read tool, a write tool, a panel and a hook.
author: Agent Cloud Studio contributors

tools.name: count_notes
tools.description: Says how many notes have been saved and shows the newest ones. Use it to recall what was noted earlier.

latest.description: How many of the newest notes to include. Default 3.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Saves a short note so that it can be found again later.
